messages.content:

Next milestone: Phase 2B.6 — Executive ribbon composition.
Inspect the ribbon container before any extraction:
Bashcd /Users/erictouko/dev/korelumina

echo "===== EXECUTIVE RIBBON SOURCE ====="
sed -n '1,360p' \
  apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/knowledge-v3/layout/ExecutiveRibbon.tsx

echo
echo "===== EXECUTIVE RIBBON RELATED FILES ====="
find \
  apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/knowledge-v3/layout \
  -maxdepth 1 \
  -type f \
  -name 'Executive*' \
  | sort

echo
echo "===== EXECUTIVE RIBBON USAGES ====="
grep -R \
  "ExecutiveRibbon" \
  apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/knowledge \
  -n \
  | sed -n '1,220p'

echo
echo "===== CURRENT LUMINA EXECUTIVE COMPONENTS ====="
find \
  apps/lumina-builder/src/components/design-system/lumina/executive \
  -maxdepth 4 \
  -type f \
  | sort

echo
echo "===== CURRENT WORKTREE ====="
git status --short
Do not patch yet. The target is only the reusable responsive ribbon layout. Knowledge must retain identity, operational status, metrics, and all domain composition decisions.

Phase 2B.6 is visually certified and ready to commit.
Bashcd /Users/erictouko/dev/korelumina

git add \
  apps/lumina-builder/src/components/design-system/lumina/executive/index.ts \
  apps/lumina-builder/src/components/design-system/lumina/executive/ribbon \
  apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/knowledge-v3/layout/ExecutiveRibbon.tsx

echo "===== STAGED FILES ====="
git diff --cached --name-only

echo
echo "===== PROTECTED FILE CHECK ====="
if git diff --cached --name-only \
  | grep -Fq \
  "apps/lumina-builder/src/components/workspaces/runtime/parts/RuntimeHeader.tsx"
then
  echo "ERROR: RuntimeHeader.tsx was staged"
  exit 1
fi

echo
echo "===== STAGED DIFF CHECK ====="
git diff --cached --check

echo
echo "===== FINAL BUILD ====="
npm run build

git commit -m "feat(lumina): extract executive ribbon"

git push origin inspect/runtime-certified-main

echo
echo "===== LATEST COMMIT ====="
git log -1 --oneline

echo
echo "===== STATUS ====="
git status --short
